newsitem.title: USA: Calif Micro sees Q1 loss around $0.15/shr.
newsitem.headline: Calif Micro sees Q1 loss around $0.15/shr.

text.p: California Microwave Inc said it expects to report a loss "in the vicinity" of $0.15 per share in the fiscal 1997 first quarter ending September 30.
The company cited lower than planned levels of bookings and sales, the delay of certain large satellite communications orders, and product pricing pressures for the loss.
But it said it expects new orders booked for the quarter "to meet or exceed" the $91 million reported in the fiscal 1996 fourth quarter.
The company said orders in the satellite communications area are "weak" this quarter but orders for wireless communications products "are improving." It said it will report results on October 16.
The company's forecast of a $0.15 per share loss compares with analysts' consensus forecast of a $0.12 per share profit in the first quarter, according to First Call.
In the year-ago first quarter, the company earned $5.1 million or $0.31 per share, on sales of $115.8 million.
